correctness.rationale: Reconstructed Gaussian conditioning: B_t | B_s=0 has variance t(s-t)/s for t<=s, (t-s)(1-t)/(1-s) for t>=s. Occupation density and Tonelli yield E[L I_q] by integrating p_s(0)*(2q-1)!! v(s,t)^q, whose time integral is beta(q+1,q+1)[s^(q+1)+(1-s)^(q+1)]. The s integral is beta(q+3/2,1/2); E[L]=sqrt(pi/2), E[I_q]=q!/[2^q(2q+1)]. Beta/gamma duplication gives the central-binomial bracket; strict negativity for q>=1 follows binom(2n,n)<2^(2n-1) for n>=2. q=0 is constant. Independent high precision beta/coefficient evaluations q=0..12 agreed.
